parsed.explanation: No trans-specific statute, no presentation offence, no criminalisation of same-sex conduct and no documented facility, custody or border rule aimed at trans visitors — so this is not a severe-risk dossier. But nothing protects either: Article 176 and local ordinances are documented as the instruments used against LGBTQ people, with imprisoned expression a real possibility, and the stakeholder record (2024) states the state neither protects nor promotes these rights. Worse, violence is attributed to police, security forces and the army, and militias in the east commit extreme violence with near-total impunity amid collapsed authority — the state as perpetrator, with no remedy (rule 11 liability, tier 2). Enforcement frequency, incident counts and all trans-specific detail are absent, so I weigh the documented impunity and state violence as pattern evidence but not as organised sweeps; hence just above the 0.25 anchors, well below 0.35.
